requirement: 需受控映射／换算及适用专业依据；无法证实时阻断申报资料确认。

environment.identity: local OIDC issuer of the test (RS256, typ at+jwt, JWKS by discovery); no real identity provider

actors.config.reviewer: 配置与交易档案发布人（独立复核）
actors.cost.checker: 核价复核（核实、评估、冻结）

chain: BRC-001 with L4 in DOZEN: the S3 chain adapted (cnat_dozen_integration_test.go) and D1 §5 steps 1–14 and 17 adapted to export lot lot.1
observed: 单位不同: L4 (ST01.blue.M) sold at 96.00 USD per DOZEN through POL's conversion dozen.ST01.blue.M (base quantity 48 PCS), bought, inspected, delivered and shipped as 4 DOZEN; lot.1 960.00 USD with line E4 4 DOZEN

无法证实时阻断: item 1 (E1–E3, 72 PCS) verified; item 2 (E4, 4 DOZEN) unverified — reason unit_not_converted, no base or legal quantity guessed; confirming → DECLARATION_MAPPING_UNVERIFIED /args/version (Items without a verified mapping: 2)

受控换算: a conversion revision POL does not have → 422 REFERENCE_INVALID at /args/items/1/lines/0/unit_conversion; with dozen.ST01.blue.M r1 (factor 12, its professional basis) version 2 is verified: 4 DOZEN = 48 PCS = 48 件; confirming version 1 → REFERENCE_STALE; version 2 confirmed, submitted and released

票据单位: invoice 33002611031 states line 2 as 4 DOZEN ("针织T恤 蓝M（打）"), matched to the DOZEN commitment line L4 and allocated to export line E4 (4 DOZEN) — balances [line 1 72/72 PCS line 2 4/4 DOZEN]; the declaration declares the same goods as 48 件 through the controlled conversion; the invoice's description is not compared with the declaration name (the verified profile maps it, C3a decision 6)
not_executed: China customs (single window): submissions and receipts are recorded manually by the documentation clerk (CN-M01); the receipts' original texts are synthetic
the tax authority: invoices are synthetic scans imported and verified by tax.officer; refund declarations, approvals and payments are recorded from synthetic evidence
the bank: fund records are entered by treasury from synthetic bank advices
the carrier's, forwarder's and inspection agency's systems: bookings, B/Ls and reports are entered from EVD evidence
a real identity provider (the test's local OIDC issuer mints every token)
the user interface (中文操作 is outside the API repository)
deviations: the unit difference is a sales line in DOZEN carried end to end (quote, purchase, QLT, delivery, shipment, lot, invoice), adapted from the S3 chain in cnat_dozen_integration_test.go; the S3 chain's read-back and uniqueness phases are not run for this variant
refusals: 422 DECLARATION_MAPPING_UNVERIFIED /api/brant/v1/cnx/commands/declaration_case.confirm by doc.1 (CN-AT03: declaration without a controlled conversion)
chain_refusals: 409 PURCHASE_DRAFT_COMMITTED /api/brant/v1/pur/commands/purchase.draft.void by purchaser (§5 step 8: PUR purchase commitment)
